builds.title: Refactor: everything left to build, one build (Oct 28 2026)
builds.detail:
Brett, Oct 28 2026 15:26: "Stop everything from every session right now except the documentation. Put everything left to build into 1 single build in a new session. Send the build to orchestrator and create the matrix then end all other sessions."

One build holding every unfinished step in the Refactor profile (17 source builds, now archived with a note pointing here). Run it in ONE new session; one Fable phase, then one Opus phase (one model switch).

Rules for this build:
- The feature matrix (_claude/builds/profiles/refactor/matrices.json, matrix "refactor-all") is the scope. Kept items are the steps below; skipped items stay in the matrix and are not built. Ticking a skipped item = add it as a step (feature-matrix Apply, once built).
- Carry on from the existing branches and PRs; don't redo finished steps. Open PRs: basic-filter #155 (CI green, merge approval sent), windows-terminal #158, amberx-handsfree #141, enterprise-branding PR #128 + interface-roller PR #129 (stacked; Opus work on opus/enterprise-branding).
- Enterprise-branding's refactor runs first in the Opus phase, so every plugin built after it lands on the refactored console. Every UI in this build is held to framework/spec/DESIGN-LANGUAGE.md, not just the §13 scope.
- Patches stays paused; skip Patches in every re-bake. Android only in apps/amberx-droid.
- Kept: 30 h 50 min (11 h 45 min Fable). Skipped by default: 10 h 25 min.

Source branches: amberx-handsfree: claude/amberx-handsfree https://github.com/MossesX/AmberX-AXF/pull/141; apply-all-levels-fable: -; approval-costs: -; arch-foundation: fable/arch-foundation; axhub-github-write: -; basic-filter: claude/basic-filter #155; enterprise-branding: fable/enterprise-branding; feature-matrix: -; interface-roller: fable/interface-roller; pending-grid-view: claude/pending-grid-view; postponed-gestures: -; share-search: -; style-package-fable: fable/style-package; tools-plugin: -; trim-asset: claude/trim-asset; veto-window: -; windows-terminal: claude/windows-terminal #158

Matrix page (Brett ticks keep/skip on his phone): https://claude.ai/artifact/GJ4gkXZUkjZVXkdKDT1zGS — artifact db doc matrix/refactor-all. Before each step, read it (db_get) and follow its keep/skip; if applyRequestedAt is newer than the last step, re-sync matrices.json and add/skip steps to match.

builds.title: Pipeline test: 3 tiny docs edits
builds.detail:
Test plan for the repaired pipeline: three one-line docs edits, each in its own file, so the VPS split makes 3 steps that never share files.

## Steps
1. Add one line "Pipeline test step 1" to the end of docs/pipeline-test/step-1.md (create the file).
2. Add one line "Pipeline test step 2" to the end of docs/pipeline-test/step-2.md (create the file).
3. Add one line "Pipeline test step 3" to the end of docs/pipeline-test/step-3.md (create the file).

## What we're watching
In the orchestrator and Plan Studio at the same time: build number, step IDs, Fable split badge plus model badge on each step, every state from pending to landed, the draft PR number at start, and the merge line.

notes.text: Plan Studio 2.0 item: pipeline-test-3-tiny-docs-edits-5hxf (Pipeline test: 3 tiny docs edits). Passed plan-build@1; sent as one Pipeline 2.0 build with 0 planning steps. The splitting stage designs its build steps; Plan Studio lists them from this store once they are filed.
Split by Fable into 3 steps (10 min). The triage gate assigns the models.

Store: refused a write by orchestrator, nothing of it was kept: s1 step s1 was replaced by another (pipeline-test-3-docs is split (Pending): its steps are fixed, none is removed or replaced); s2 step s2 was replaced by another (pipeline-test-3-docs is split (Pending): its steps are fixed, none is removed or replaced); s3 step s3 was replaced by another (pipeline-test-3-docs is split (Pending): its steps are fixed, none is removed or replaced)

steps.text: Create docs/pipeline-test/step-1.md (new file, create the docs/pipeline-test/ folder if missing) with the single line "Pipeline test step 1" at the end of the file. Touch no other file. Commit.
Create docs/pipeline-test/step-2.md (new file, create the docs/pipeline-test/ folder if missing) with the single line "Pipeline test step 2" at the end of the file. Touch no other file. Commit.

Create docs/pipeline-test/step-3.md (new file, create the docs/pipeline-test/ folder if missing) with the single line "Pipeline test step 3" at the end of the file. Then cover tests and the report: check that the file exists and ends with exactly that line, run `node framework/cli/builds-store.mjs verify`, and write _claude/builds/reports/pipeline-test-3-docs.md saying what the build is (a pipeline test of three one-line docs edits, one file per step: docs/pipeline-test/step-1.md, step-2.md, step-3.md, with steps 1 and 2 built in their own worktrees), the check results, and what to watch in the orchestrator and Plan Studio (build number, step IDs, split and model badges, every state from pending to landed, the draft PR number, the merge line).
